pages.title: Manage Players
pages.text: In Settings, use Manage beside Trusted players.$(br2)Add an online player name or a complete UUID for an offline player. The list supports up to 64 players.

pages.title: Manage Players
pages.text: Remove revokes their access through Trusted mode.

pages.title: Change Owner
pages.text: Use the menu beside Owner to transfer ownership.$(br2)Enter an online name or UUID. Transferring clears the old trusted list and may remove your management access.

pages.title: Unclaimed Displays
pages.text: An operator can claim an unowned legacy display before it can be edited.$(br2)New displays placed by a player belong to that player. Automated placement leaves displays unclaimed.
